About Us

More than just engineers — your partners in building a brighter, sustainable future.

Who We Are

Building a Brighter & Sustainable Future

At Folybim, we are more than just engineers — we are your partners in building a brighter and sustainable future.

We specialize in designing, constructing, and installing cutting-edge power systems for industrial, commercial, and residential needs. Whether you need a reliable solution for powering your business or are exploring renewable energy options, our team is here to deliver innovative and efficient results.

Headquartered at Suite 25, Oja Oba Shopping Complex, Abule-Egba, Lagos, Folybim Engineering Company Nigeria Limited maintains structured, safety-conscious, quality-driven standards across electrical, mechanical, and civil engineering service areas. These standards ensure dependable engineering outcomes, positioning us as a technically capable, environmentally responsible, and professionally reliable contractor suitable for public and private sector projects.

At Folybim Engineering, we’re not just powering the present — we’re building the future.

Credentials & Standards

Company Standards & Certifications

Folybim Engineering maintains disciplined engineering procedures across electrical, mechanical, and civil services in full compliance with regulatory standards.

Corporate Affairs Commission

Folybim Engineering Company Nigeria Limited — registered under the Companies and Allied Matters Act. Certificate of Incorporation & Memorandum and Articles of Association held.

COREN Certified

The Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria (COREN) has certified Folybim Engineering, confirming our compliance with national engineering practice standards.

Disciplined Execution Standards

Comprehensive engineering lifecycle management: load forecasting, system modeling, earthing and protection systems, strict conduit wiring, and QA/QC performance testing before commissioning.
